feedback.text: Shot 1, Straighten the elbow through the snap; aim ≥ 150°. Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~80°).
Shot 2, dave, Lock the rim with your eyes, then lift. Snap the wrist so fingers point down on the finish. Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~101°).
Shot 3, Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~81°). Square your feet a touch more to the rim (88° off).
Shot 4, Pick the target earlier — eyes to the rim. Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~89°).
Shot 5, Hold the follow-through for a full beat. Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~86°).
Shot 6, Square your feet a touch more to the rim (64° off). Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~103°).
Shot 7, dave, Get the index under the wrist at finish. Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~88°).
Shot 8, Drive the elbow long on finish (currently 93°). Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~93°).
Shot 9, Lock the rim with your eyes, then lift. Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~94°).
Shot 10, Keep the arm up; hold your pose briefly. Finish with stronger arm extension (now ~82°).
